label: Early-sequence articles
explanation: Fires on the articles "a", "the", "an" (21–36% conditional rates vs 2.1% baseline), but almost only near the start of a sequence — ~10% firing rate in the first 16 tokens, dropping to zero in the second half. Strongest on "a"/"the" at positions 0–3 (e.g. chunks opening "buy a…", "creates a…"), with weak spillover onto adjacent function words; it stays silent on content words and on all tokens past mid-sequence.
